title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MARKING OF ANIMALS AFFLICTED WITH SURRA.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MARKING OF ANIMALS AFFLICTED WITH SURRA.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định việc đánh dấu động vật bị nhiễm bệnh surra

title.id: Undang-Undang menyediakan penandaan hewan yang terserang penyakit surra
title.ms: Akta menyediakan penandaan haiwan yang dijangkiti penyakit surra

text.en:
It shall be lawful for any duly authorized agent of the Board of Health for the Philippine Islands
or of the Bureau of Government Laboratories to mark any animal found to be afflicted with surra by
fastening in its right ear a metal tag marked with the letter "S" and with a number.

It shall be unlawful to remove any such tag affixed as provided, in section one of this Act until the
animal so marked has been pronounced free from surra by a duly authorized agent of the Board of Health or
of the Bureau of Government Laboratories. Any person removing a tag in violation of this section shall, upon
conviction, be punished by a fine of not less than five nor more than fifty pesos for each offense.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 14, 1904.
